lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 visible high-contrast vertical line segments with relatively uniform spacing of approximately 5-8% of the total torso width between each primary line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th line from the anterior, splitting in the upper third of the flank region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 10, and 11 are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank before reaching the lower ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 distinct white spots localized on the upper hindquarters and posterior flank, situated behind the final vertical line.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align in a semi-horizontal geometric chain across the upper mid-thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white banding on the anterior of the lower forelimbs and large, ovoid pinnae with dark outer margins and internal white hair tufts.
